study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study (from a clinical trial)
outcome: unplanned revisits (unplanned clinic, ER visits, hospital readmissions)
cohort: The study included 1850 infants, presumably all born via Cesarean section, who were participants in the Cesarean Section Optimal Antibiotic Prophylaxis trial.
finding: Multiple risk factors were identified for both unplanned revisits and hospital readmissions in early infancy following nonelective Cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Elective repeat C/section was identified as a protective risk factor for hospital readmission (aOR 0.72).
